questions.question: Which improvements should be included? Select every choice that applies.

options.label: Faster responses (Recommended)
options.description: Prioritize changes that reduce how long the workflow takes.

options.label: Simpler controls
options.description: Reduce the number of steps and choices shown during normal use.

options.label: Better accessibility
options.description: Improve keyboard navigation, focus visibility, and screen-reader support.

options.label: Safer defaults
options.description: Add clearer confirmations and reduce accidental actions.

options.label: More customization
options.description: Let people adjust appearance and behavior to their preferences.

questions.question: How should the changes be introduced?

options.label: Preview first (Recommended)
options.description: Try the changes in a disposable environment before making them active.

options.label: Gradual rollout
options.description: Enable the changes in stages so problems are easier to contain.

options.label: Enable immediately
options.description: Make the changes active as soon as validation finishes.

options.label: Document only
options.description: Prepare the instructions but do not activate the changes.

options.label: Important results only (Recommended)
options.description: Notify only when work finishes or needs attention.

options.label: Every update
options.description: Notify for progress updates as well as final results.

options.label: No notifications
options.description: Keep all updates inside the conversation.

questions.question: Which evidence should be required before the work is considered complete?

options.label: Automated tests (Recommended)
options.description: Require repeatable checks that can run without manual interaction.

options.label: Visual check
options.description: Confirm the interface looks and behaves correctly in the app.

options.label: Restart check
options.description: Confirm the behavior still works after closing and reopening the app.

options.label: Fallback check
options.description: Confirm a clear alternative remains available when the preferred tool fails.
